title: feat(console): a refusal that names several reasons lists every one in its alert box
body:
Fixes #37403

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The widening: `@object-ui/types` adds the export `ActionRefusalLine` and the optional member `ActionResult.refusals`, and `@object-ui/core` adds the optional member `ActionResponseOutcome.refusals`. Nothing is narrowed; every package ships `patch`.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在控制台的操作弹窗里，一次拒绝带多条原因时，红色提示框逐行列出每一条原因，最后一行是总结句；不再只显示第一句、其余藏在「更多」里。只有一句的拒绝照旧显示。
- 为什么做：接服务端「一次拒绝给出多条已翻译原因」那张卡（多原因拒绝），让批量提交被整体拒绝的用户一眼看到每一条为什么不行。
- 出错会怎样：只影响带多条原因的拒绝提示；最坏是提示框少显示总结句，原因本身仍全部列出；可直接撤回本改动，恢复成「首句 + 更多」。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Ruling on #36877, term (6), verbatim: "Console: a ui follow-up card under this one renders a multi-line `userMessage` as a list in the alert box."

- **The carrier.** The `/actions` door answers a multi-reason refusal's sentences on `error.details.refusals: [{ reason, message }]` (PR #37395), but the console dropped `details` before the refusal box: `interpretActionResponse` read only `fields` and `userMessage`, and `ActionResult` had no member for the list. Now `refusalLines` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionResponse.ts`) reads the list whole or not at all, by the element rule of the server's reader (`declaredRefusalLines`): a non-empty list, every element `{ reason: string, message: string }`. It does not re-check that reader's `userMessage` condition, because it reads only what the server answered. `createServerActionHandler` relays it on the new `ActionResult.refusals` (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`, element type `ActionRefusalLine`), next to `userMessage`.
- **The dialog.** `ActionParamDialog` keeps the refused run's `refusals` with its text and passes them to `RefusalMessage` as `lines`.
- **The box.** With `lines`, `RefusalMessage` renders one list: every listed reason in order, then the refusal's closing sentence, and no "More" toggle. Following the zone note on the card (7181225232), the reasons come from `details.refusals` and are never split out of the text. The closing sentence is not on that list. The server sends it only as the last line of the text, after the reasons joined by line breaks, so it is read from there, and only when the text still starts with exactly those reasons. If the text was cut inside the reasons (the `/data` door cuts `userMessage` at 500 characters), every reason is still shown and the closing sentence is left out. Without `lines`, or with an empty list, the component behaves as before.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.tsx`: `refusalListItems`, which picks the closing sentence.
2. `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionResponse.ts`: `refusalLines`, the shape reader.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx`: the `refusalLines` state set next to `refusal`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/components/RefusalMessage.test.tsx`. Expect the new `(objectstack#37403)` describe to pass: three list items in order (two reasons, then "Nothing was submitted."), no `refusal-more`.

## Tests

- `RefusalMessage.test.tsx`: a new top-level describe. Multi-reason (every line in order, closing line last, one list, no More). Text cut inside the reasons (both reasons shown from the list, no closing line). CONTROL: a single-sentence refusal with no list renders as text alone. CONTROL: an empty list is no list.
- `ActionParamDialog.refusalKeepsInput-13161.test.tsx`: a new top-level describe. A refused run with `refusals` lists them in the `action-param-refusal` alert box.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionResponse.test.ts`: `details.refusals` carried in order and copied to `reason`/`message`. CONTROL: an absent list, an empty list, a malformed element or a non-list carries none.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/serverActionHandler.test.ts`: the handler relays `refusals` beside `error` and `userMessage`.
- The fixture sentences match the `/actions` door answer pinned on the server side in `action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts` (the `[#36877] an action's reasons list` describe), in English.

<details><summary>Ablation (one, on the list branch)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `RefusalMessage.tsx`, anchor `if (!lines || lines.length === 0) return null;` replaced by `if (/* ABLATED_37403 */ true) return null;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 10d87495 to 81dba40e): 3 failed / 21 passed. The three failures are the multi-reason case, the cut-text case and the dialog case. The controls stay green. Restored: blob equals HEAD (10d87495), `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import the component from `src/`, so no rebuild was needed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Reach: today the console renders `RefusalMessage` for an action refusal only in the param dialog. An action without params reports its refusal as a toast, which shows `userMessage` (the joined lines) and is not part of this card. The `/data` door (record save) does not reach `RefusalMessage`.
- A closing line that the 500-character cut lands inside, after all the reasons, is shown as the cut text ends, with its ellipsis. The console cannot tell a cut closing line from one that ends in an ellipsis without knowing the server's bound. The `/actions` door, the only door that reaches this box, does not cut.
- The card's pins live in the existing harness files as top-level describes (AGENTS.md, ruling record 6583487846), not in a new file named for the card as the claim's file surface said.
